generation.scope: All center-finite standard regular finite-edge windows of vertex index up to four have four central parameters in path degree eight, including every exceptional fiber. On the fifteen-dimensional closure the criterion for a regular semiprime, domain or Noetherian window drops from path degree 564 to 84 (quotient 29 and complexes 32). In every component the same test plus a generic rank bound decides the center-finite regular branch through index four.

open_mathematics: Classify the remaining non-Noetherian finite PI degenerations using their smaller simple representations and analyze the geometry of the octic normalization, including classification outside the fifteen-dimensional component.
